title: The Submerged Peak
subtitle: A Family's Secrets Surface After Sudden Deaths
summary: When tragedy strikes the influential Samaddar family, Byomkesh Bakshi is drawn into a web of political intrigue and personal secrets. As hidden truths begin to rise to the surface, the line between protector and suspect blurs. Unravel the enigma behind the deaths that haunt this prosperous household—where every motive is as deep as the secrets submerged beneath.
